tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Current SwiftPrism plans and prices by country (one paid plan, Elite, plus Free), and the free trial terms. Generated from the live price catalog.

tools.name: get_features
tools.description: What Elite and Free include: real-time US stock and world economic headlines, studio Headline Voice, Market Momentum, Deep Insights™, Economic Calendar, holdings, reading languages. Also what SwiftPrism does not do.

tools.name: get_languages
tools.description: Languages a SwiftPrism Elite member can read headlines, Deep Insights™, and the Economic Calendar in, and hear Headline Voice in.

tools.name: start_trial
tools.description: Returns the link a person opens to start the free Elite trial. The person creates the account and accepts the Terms themselves. No card is needed. This tool does not create an account or send email.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Returns the link where a person pays for Elite (monthly or yearly). Payment happens on a Stripe page (card, Apple Pay, or Link) after the person signs in. Agents never enter card details. Most people should start with start_trial instead.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_features" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
